challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Two Alex-initiated one-on-one outings and acceptance of a third provide meaningful support for special interest, but HA-F4 shows that Alex also makes occasional one-on-one plans with another friend.

Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and including Jordan's preferred tea demonstrate personalized attention, though the tea was one of several options brought to a group meeting and HA-F4 establishes broader attentiveness.

Three extended post-event conversations involving personal updates and possible future activities strengthen A, but their mixed group and personal content does not clearly establish romantic interest.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: The reconsidered facts collectively make A somewhat better supported than B, but not sufficiently better supported to displace genuine indeterminacy. HA-F4 provides a plausible general-friendliness explanation, HA-F5 contains no explicit romantic signal, and HA-F6 shows interest in rescheduling without definite follow-through.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: The pattern supports possible special interest but remains compatible with friendship, so direct clarification is more reliable than inferring intent from the existing behavior.
